en-US.title: Bolo: Speak Hindi
en-US.subtitle: Real-life conversation skills
en-US.description:
Practice Hindi for the moments that happen in real life.

Bolo helps you move from recognizing words to choosing a natural response. Work through 100 short lessons in 10 guided plans, plus 30 standalone real-life scenes for cafés, transport, shopping, travel, work, social visits, and everyday errands. Health scenes are language exercises and do not provide medical advice.

GUIDED PRACTICE
• Read Hindi in Devanagari with transliteration and an English meaning
• Choose a response and get immediate feedback
• After consent, hear Hindi lines in Asha's AI voice
• Save useful phrases for quick review
• Track your daily practice and streak on your device

OPTIONAL COACHING WITH ASHA
After a separate consent step, use AI Listen, type a message, use GPT Realtime voice turns, or record pronunciation. Choose English or Hindi replies, tap the glowing orb to begin a voice turn, speak naturally, then tap the orb again to send. AI voice and connected coaching require an internet connection.

YOUR CHOICE
The 100 short lessons and 30 standalone scenes, saved phrases, and practice progress are available without an account or internet. AI features are optional, and consent can be withdrawn in Settings. AI replies can be reported from inside the app.

Bolo is a language-practice tool. AI responses may be inaccurate; do not rely on Bolo for professional translation, medical advice, or emergency help.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial release with 100 short Hindi lessons in 10 guided plans, 30 standalone real-life scenes, saved phrases, daily practice tracking, consent-gated AI voice playback, and optional typed, live voice, and pronunciation coaching with Asha.
en-US.promoText: Practice practical Hindi through 10 guided plans, 100 short lessons, and 30 standalone scenes, with optional coaching from Asha.

review.notes:
No account, login, purchase, or subscription is required. The 100 short lessons and 30 standalone scenes work without connected coaching.

To review AI voice in a scene, open a scene, accept the versioned AI data-use consent, and tap Listen. The audio is generated by the server AI voice; the app has no device text-reader fallback.

To review connected coaching, open Practice with Asha and accept the same consent if needed. Keep English selected, type ‘How do I say thank you?’, and verify an English reply with AI voice playback. Select हिन्दी, type the same question, and verify a Hindi reply. Tap the glowing orb; this requests microphone permission, opens a WebRTC media stream with its audio track initially disabled, and begins the turn. Tap the orb again to send. Microphone transmission is enabled only during an active turn, remains disabled between turns, and the stream is released at End, when leaving the screen, or when the app leaves the foreground. Live voice does not create a recording file or capture microphone audio in the background. A scene answer can be recorded for pronunciation feedback. Generated live and pronunciation replies include a Report control.

Settings allows consent withdrawal and deletion of local data plus server reports linked to the app's random identifier. AI voice and connected coaching require internet access. Pharmacy and doctor scenes teach language phrasing and are not medical advice. Bolo does not record in the background.
